components.name: Try NeuroGrid
components.description: One of two equally prominent homepage actions.
components.css: .ds-button-primary { font: 650 14px/1.35 Inter, "Segoe UI", system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; padding: 9px 15px; min-height: 40px; border: 1px solid #252d41; border-radius: 8px; transition: background-color .18s ease, border-color .18s ease; background: #a5a1ff; border-color: #a5a1ff; color: #0d0d21; } .ds-button-primary:hover { background: #c3c0ff; border-color: #c3c0ff; color: #070819; } .ds-button-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #a5a1ff; outline-offset: 4px; } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-button-primary { transition: none; } }

components.name: Sign in
components.description: Bordered action used in the site header.
components.css: .ds-button-secondary { font: 650 14px/1.35 Inter, "Segoe UI", system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; padding: 9px 15px; min-height: 40px; border: 1px solid #252d41; border-radius: 8px; transition: background-color .18s ease, border-color .18s ease; background: transparent; color: #f1f3fb; } .ds-button-secondary:hover { background: #141b2c; border-color: #7974ae; } .ds-button-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #a5a1ff; outline-offset: 4px; } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-button-secondary { transition: none; } }

components.name: Prompt field
components.description: The dark, resizable textarea in the chat composer.

components.name: Site navigation
components.description: Bright text and a violet underline indicate the current page.
components.html: HomeChatNetworkLedgerDownloads
components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: clamp(16px, 3vw, 34px); background: #0a0d17; border-bottom: 1px solid #252d41; } .ds-nav a { font: 550 14px Inter, "Segoe UI", system-ui, sans-serif; padding-block: 27px 25px; white-space: nowrap; color: #a3aec5; text-decoration: none; border-bottom: 2px solid transparent; } .ds-nav a:hover, .ds-nav a[aria-current="page"] { color: #f1f3fb; } .ds-nav a[aria-current="page"] { border-color: #a29aff; } .ds-nav a:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #a5a1ff; outline-offset: 4px; } @media (max-width: 650px) { .ds-nav { gap: 12px; justify-content: space-between; } .ds-nav a { padding-block: 13px 11px; font-size: 13px; } }

components.name: Partition card
components.description: Displays a partition, its layer range and coordinator-reported node availability.
components.html:

components.css: .ds-partition { background: #101523; color: #f1f3fb; border: 1px solid #252d41; border-radius: 11px; padding: 21px; min-height: 156px; font-family: Inter, "Segoe UI", system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-partition-top { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; gap: 8px; margin-bottom: 19px; color: #a7a4fb; } .ds-partition-top span { font: 11px/1.4 ui-monospace, monospace; letter-spacing: .07em; color: #adb9d3; } .ds-partition h3 { font-size: 19px; font-weight: 660; letter-spacing: -.027em; margin: 0; } .ds-partition p { font-size: 14px; color: #a3aec5; line-height: 1.6; margin: 6px 0 0; } .ds-partition-status { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; margin-top: 15px; font-size: 13px; color: #c1cce2; } .ds-available { width: 8px; height: 8px; border-radius: 50%; background: #64e8b4; box-shadow: 0 0 10px #64e8b45c; } @media (max-width: 650px) { .ds-partition { min-height: auto; padding: 16px; } .ds-partition-top { margin-bottom: 10px; } }

narrative.overview: The public website pairs large editorial headlines with a navy graphite palette. Three cobalt-lit chips illustrate the model partitions on the homepage. Chat, Network, Ledger, and Downloads carry the same typography and palette into compact operational views.
keyCharacteristics: Equal visual prominence for trying chat and contributing compute.
Thin rules and compact panels for technical data.
Text labels for availability, progress, and verification.
dos: Do pair each availability indicator with a visible or accessible status label.
Do keep the ledger and node registry compact and preserve the readability of identifiers at mobile sizes.
